installCommand: npm install --global --prefix="$HOME/.npm-global" pnpm@9.15.9 && export PATH="$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$PATH" && cd ../.. && pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
buildCommand: export PATH="$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$PATH" && cd ../.. && VERCEL=1 pnpm build && rm -rf apps/api/out && cp -R apps/web/out apps/api/out
